prompt: Halloween-themed web app UI for finding nearby restaurants and bars in Korea. All UI text in Korean. App name: '근처 맛집·술집' with a jack-o'-lantern motif. Dark spooky theme: near-black purple night background, pumpkin orange primary accent, toxic green and ghostly purple secondary accents, subtle cobwebs, bats, moon, and fog decorations — fun and playful, not gory. Layout (desktop): top header bar with app title, a search row (text input placeholder '주소나 장소명 (예: 강남역, 성수동)', orange '검색' button, '📍 내 위치' button), below that filter chips '전체' / '🎃 맛집' / '🦇 술집' (one active) and a radius select '반경 500m'. Main area: left sidebar (~380px) with a status line '반경 500m 안에 맛집·술집 24곳 (가까운 순)' and a scrollable list of place cards — each card shows a small badge ('맛집' orange or '술집' purple), restaurant name, distance like '120m' on the right, category ('한식 > 국밥'), address, phone, and small links '카카오맵', '네이버지도', '길찾기'. Right side: a large dark-styled map with glowing pumpkin-shaped markers for restaurants, bat/ghost-shaped markers for bars, a blue 'you are here' marker and a dashed orange radius circle. Footer line in sidebar: '데이터: 카카오 로컬'. Spooky display font for the title, clean readable sans-serif for body text.
